title: Polite noun sentences
summary: Use the English meaning and the Japanese context. Type Japanese, preserving small kana and long vowels.

c01.sentenceGloss: As for me, I am a student.
c01.note: The topic particle is written は and pronounced /wa/.

c02.note: End a polite affirmative noun sentence with です.

c04.note: Polite negative of a noun sentence.

c05.sentenceGloss: My younger sister is a student too.
c05.note: も means also or too; the gloss distinguishes this from は.

c06.note: の links the possessor to the noun.
